latest.title: Create a phased credential migration path with IAM Access Analyzer
latest.description: This article outlines a four-phase approach - discover, deactivate, delete, and replace -for migrating away from static AWS IAM access keys using IAM Access Analyzer and automated Step Functions workflows. It provides practical guidance on safely identifying unused credentials, eliminating security risks through reversible deactivation and human-approved deletion, and transitioning to temporary credential mechanisms like IAM roles and IAM Identity Center.

latest.title: Erros de segurança que iniciantes cometem na AWS (e como evitar)
latest.description: Começar a utilizar a AWS é um processo ágil e acessível, porém essa facilidade pode levar à negligência de aspectos fundamentais de segurança. Este conteúdo apresenta os principais erros cometidos por iniciantes e orienta sobre como evitá-los na prática, desde o uso inadequado do usuário root até a exposição de credenciais e a ausência de monitoramento. Trata-se de um guia objetivo para fortalecer a segurança da sua conta desde o início e prevenir riscos operacionais e financeiros

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.
